title: Supernotes: Driving Consensus in Crowd-Sourced Fact-Checking

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the neutrality of fact-checking notes by having a politically balanced group of human participants (an equal split of self-reported left-leaning and right-leaning individuals) rate US politics posts on whether the notes use neutral, unbiased language rather than being argumentative, speculative, or partisan. The study also utilizes LLMs in a 'Principle Alignment' step to filter out generated text containing biased language.
